coverage_override.reason: The material/proper-summon procedure and the card's three activated effects are four audit units.

effects.printed_clause: 3 Rank 9 Dragon monsters; must first be Xyz Summoned from the Extra Deck.
effects.lua_implementation: A level-free Xyz procedure requires exactly three face-up Rank 9 Dragon Xyz Monsters, and EnableReviveLimit requires a proper first Summon.

official_references.matched_structure: Registers an Xyz procedure and enables the proper-Summon revive limit.

effects.printed_clause: Once per turn: target another Xyz Monster you control; attach it to this card as material and transfer its materials.
effects.lua_implementation: A soft once-per-turn targeted Ignition Effect overlays the target's existing materials onto this card and then overlays the target itself.

official_references.matched_structure: Transfers a selected Xyz Monster's overlay group before attaching that monster.
Targets and attaches a field monster as Xyz Material.

effects.printed_clause: When a card or effect is activated: detach Xyz materials equal to the number of times this card has activated this effect this turn, then negate that activation.
effects.lua_implementation: The cost reads the handler's current per-turn activation flag count, detaches exactly that many materials only when the count is positive, then increments the flag. The first activation therefore costs zero, the second one, and so on; resolution negates the activation.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses an EVENT_CHAINING Quick Effect, overlay-detach cost checking, and Duel.NegateActivation.

effects.issue: Fixed: removed the erroneous +1 from the escalating cost, so the cost equals prior activations exactly and starts at zero.

effects.printed_clause: If this card has no Xyz material: You can destroy it, then Special Summon 1 other Xyz Monster from your GY.
effects.lua_implementation: A zero-overlay targeted Ignition Effect checks self-destruction and zone availability, destroys the handler, and only after successful destruction revives the related non-self Xyz target under Necrovalley.

official_references.matched_structure: Targets and Special Summons an Xyz Monster from the GY.
Checks a zero-material condition tied to self-destruction.
